/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.name: Titan Extractor Prime
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.description:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.descriptionEn:
Deploy the Extractor on a planet to collect large amounts of resources.

Must be emptied regularly for maximum efficiency and monitored for damage.
/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedResourceDrone.descriptionZh:
在一个星球上部署采集机来收集大量资源。

必须定期清理，才能达到最高效率并防止损坏。

/Lotus/Types/Ship/AdvancedUcResourceDron.description:
